title: Chris Kelly's physical size
summary: Robinson says Kelly resembled him, about five foot ten and heavy, unlike small Buddy Petit and Rene.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Chris Kelly, the blues trumpeter and his band

blocks.x: Well, I think of it. Did you ever see a picture of Chris Kelly? I've never seen a picture of him. That's why I didn't know what he looked like even.
He kind of resembled Nick as we used to pass for brothers.
Was he, he wasn't as big as you though I bet was he? Yeah. Was he? Well, I didn't know he was tall.
About five foot ten. I always thought maybe he was a little fella. I guess Buddy Petit was real little.
Oh, now that's the little, that was the little man. Buddy Petit and Rene. Yeah. Them was little fellas.
I saw Rene, I remember he's small.
I had the idea Chris Kelly was small too.
Oh, no. Chris was a big heavy guy. Oh, I didn't know that. Mm-hmm. That's a big, big husky.
